reason: Adds an AnySearch web-search provider to DeepSeek Harness via ctx.web, with an optional Firecrawl Developer Index fallback for developer-oriented queries.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 添加基于 AnySearch 的网页搜索提供商，并可选使用 Firecrawl Developer Index 处理开发者相关查询。
summaries.en: Adds an AnySearch web-search provider to DeepSeek Harness and optionally uses the Firecrawl Developer Index for developer-focused queries.

capabilities: Provides web search through the AnySearch MCP gateway
Optionally queries the Firecrawl Developer Index for developer-focused searches
Sends search queries and result counts to configured external services
Uses configured AnySearch and optional Firecrawl API keys
